hero.subtitle: ABOUT RAJAYOGI
hero.title: Engineering Mindset. Interaction Intuition.
hero.description: I am a Product Designer and Interaction Researcher completing an M.Sc. in Interaction Technology at the University of Twente in the Netherlands. My work explores how multimodal spatial interfaces (combining gaze, voice, and semi-autonomous robotics) can assist human workers without eroding autonomy or adding cognitive load.

mission.label: DESIGN PHILOSOPHY
mission.quote: Empowering human agency with multimodal spatial intelligence.
mission.description: Technology should never displace the human artisan or operator; it should remove friction, reduce divided visual attention, and amplify human capacity.

values.title: Worker-Centered Autonomy
values.description: Design systems where the operator retains transparent, predictable oversight over automated assistance.

values.title: Multimodal Fluidity
values.description: Seamless coordination between gaze dwell, speech commands, and physical handles to eliminate cognitive fatigue.

values.title: Empirical Rigor
values.description: Every interaction pattern is tested and validated using in-situ observation, task duration, and NASA-TLX workload subscales.
